## The two non-distinctive repositories

`glideapps/quicktype` (T0 TEST 22.570) and
`refined-github/refined-github` (T0 TEST 29.815)
fall below the frozen BV2 threshold of 30. Both:

- **remain selected** — no replacement, no backfill;
- **have full outcome results computed and reported** (see `COMPARISON.md`);
- are marked `STATIC_BASELINE_NOT_DISTINCTIVE`;
- **do not enter informative-repository disposition arithmetic**;
- count as evidence **neither for nor against H**.

B2 was not redesigned to make them informative. Note that both repositories pass
BV1, BV3, BV4, BV5 and BV6 — the failure is specifically the size of the extant
candidate test suite at T0, which is precisely what BV2 was frozen to detect.

## Import-edge ablation (BV6 / RT10)

Non-inert on **all five** repositories:

- `glideapps/quicktype` — 15.0% of 200 rankings change when all import edges are removed
- `solidjs/solid-start` — 26.5% of 200 rankings change when all import edges are removed
- `tinymce/tinymce` — 44.5% of 200 rankings change when all import edges are removed
- `tutao/tutanota` — 85.5% of 200 rankings change when all import edges are removed
- `refined-github/refined-github` — 9.0% of 200 rankings change when all import edges are removed

Live re-demonstration (RT10, `solidjs/solid-start`, 20 strided T0 graphs rebuilt from scratch):
5 probes are path-bearing and **5/5** of those change under ablation.
The remaining 15 probes have no test→source path within depth 4, so removing
edges cannot move their ranking — an identity, not a detector weakness, and
consistent with BV4 (0.295 of queries path-bearing).
